column1: # pm1.xlate glossary (2026-10-29): fixed zh <-> en terms for query translation. One term per line:
# zh -> en: the Chinese term is replaced by the first English one before translating, and every English one is added
# to the translation. en -> zh: an English term found in the query (whole words, any case) adds its Chinese term.
# Built from the mistranslations of 121 real Chinese queries (重排 -> "rearrangements", 回测 -> "return tests", ...).
# User additions: ~/.config/pm1/xlate_glossary.tsv, same format (read again when either file changes).
